description: EVALS §4.3 extra reminders. A case is correct when every proposed extra passes the planner (none dropped), every `should` item gets a kept extra, and no `must_not` item gets one. `no_extras`: no extra may be proposed at all.

cases.note: Interview tomorrow at 13:00; preferences say interviews get a reminder the day before.
The day before a high-priority job deadline (expense report, 10-28 17:00), two days before the interview.
Nothing in the window, two undated low-priority tasks.
Calendar unavailable: no event IDs were shown, so an extra for an event would be rejected.
Preferences turn extras off; even the interview gets none.
Routine meetings and low-stakes tasks only.
max_per_item is 1: two interviews, at most one extra each.
A normal Monday with birthdays today and tomorrow; birthdays already have their default reminder.
